title: Insane's Experience Tweaks
description: Enhanced Experience with better Player xp, more experience dropped and better anvils.
body:
## Summary

Experience Tweaks is a small mod that enhances Experience and Anvils with many customizations.

## The mod

### Experience

#### Players

*   Players now drop 80% of experience on death and no longer 7 levels at most
*   Levelling up always requires a fixed amount of experience instead of exponential
*   Players pick up experience faster

#### Dropped

*   Mobs drop more experience per equipment piece (even more if enchanted)
*   Bottle o' enchanting always drop a full level of experience
*   You now get experience for shearing sheep, gather honey(comb) from bee hives and brushing suspicious blocks
*   You can apply a multiplier on how much experience mobs, blocks and in general drop (disabled by default)

### Anvil

*   Repairing items cost less material than used to craft an item and costs just a bit of xp without having increasing cost.
*   The anvil has a lower chance to break
*   Renaming no longer costs levels and will not break the Anvil
*   Anvils can be fixed with Iron Blocks

This mod was part of [Insane's Survival Overhaul](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/iguanatweaks-reborn) up to 1.20.1.
